description: Microbiology request: molecular pathogen load (MII KDS Mikrobiologie 2027, profile MII_PR_Mikrobio_Molekulare_Pathogenlast, ValueSet MII_VS_Mikrobio_Molekulare_Pathogenlast_Tests_LOINC = LOINC SCALE Qn + molecular METHOD_TYP in CLASS MICRO). Quantitative nucleic-acid concentration of a pathogen: Property = number concentration, log number concentration, arbitrary concentration (IU/mL viral loads) or log arbitrary concentration; Component = the organism's nucleic acid.

queries.name: Pathogen load — quantitative microbial nucleic acid, any technique
queries.description: Viral/bacterial loads (HIV RNA, HBV DNA, CMV DNA ...) regardless of technique. Reference set for the request.
